title: Meditation Retreat Attendance vs Registration
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`faith:rosary`), retreat events (`faith:retreat`), attendance logs (`faith:attendance`), fasting journals (`faith:fast`), practice reviews (`faith:ops`).
app: Spiritual-practice telemetry — rosary counters, meditation-retreat schedules, church-attendance logs, and fasting journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=faith:retreat retreat_name=* attended=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(attended="yes",1,0))) as matched by retreat_name
| eval an_attended_retreat_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - an_attended_retreat_pct
description: Measures the percentage of retreat registrations that end with an attended retreat by retreat.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which retreat are helping or hurting retreat registrations.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `an attended retreat` on `faith:retreat` events and summarize the hit rate by `retreat_name`.
visualization: Table of retreat with percentage of retreat registrations ending with an attended retreat.
grandmaExplanation: It records how often an attended retreat happens for each retreat so you can see where retreat registrations go smoothly or get stuck.
